top_signals.title: Novogratz Says Credit Markets Are Reaching ‘Peak Nervousness’
top_signals.summary: Michael Novogratz, the billionaire founder and CEO of the crypto financial services conglomerate and artificial intelligence data-center provider Galaxy Digital Inc., said the anxiety in global credit markets over AI spending is on the verge of easing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
top_signals.summary: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
